name: [FPS] Enforcement
desc:
👍Like the Game & Join the Group to get TWO FREE Head Cosmetics

ENFORCEMENT is inspired by Authority FPS by [Logitech101] & [Spookyfox]
Features extreme loadout customization
All content is unlocked in the order of your choice for your convenience

YOU CAN NOW ACCESS ANY MAP BY PRESSING "O" IN PRIVATE SERVERS! (You have to own the server)

🎮CONTROLS:
[WASD] - Move Character
[Mouse1] - Fire Weapon
[Mouse2] - Aim Down Sights
[Middle-Mouse] - Ping Enemy Locations
[R] - Reload
[SHIFT] - Sprint
[CTRL/C] - Crouch
[SHFT+CTRL] - Dive
[SHFT+C] - Slide
[G] - Throw Lethal
[T] - Throw Tactical
[L] - Dance
[V] - Melee
[3/4/5/6] - Activate Killstreaks
